Maya: Quick standup: we need a compact GA acceptance checklist for Dedicated. Scope = SLA tiers, minimal public docs, oncall handoff, monitoring synths/dashboards, pricing (commit vs burst). Can we lock owners + deadlines today?
Alex: Propose three tiers (baseline / priority / enterprise). Keep initial policy per-customer (no mixing).
Jordan: SLO sketch (inference p95 / p99 / availability):
baseline: p95 <= 350ms, p99 <= 900ms, avail 99.5%
priority: p95 <= 220ms, p99 <= 600ms, avail 99.9%
enterprise: p95 <= 110ms, p99 <= 320ms, avail 99.95%
Also error-rate targets: baseline <1%, priority <0.5%, enterprise <0.2%.
Priya: Support rules: Platform owns detection & first-touch for infra/perf. Product owns functional/regression once triaged. Escalation windows: baseline 8h, priority 4h, enterprise 1h. I'll post a rotation list by EOD.
Elena: Docs split: public SLA card + pricing matrix + onboarding blurb; internal runbooks: escalation, fallback behaviors, dashboard guide. I can draft public pages after SLOs are finalized.
Ravi (Finance): Cost notes: priority +12-18% ops cost, enterprise +25-35%. Credits: baseline cap 5%, priority cap 12%, enterprise cap 30% (subject to Legal). Need margin sims for commit terms.
Sam: GTM: customers asked if they can opt-up a single model to enterprise. For GA we'll state no cross-model mixing; revisit later. Need a one-pager we can show Sales.
Jordan: Monitoring: add cold/warm synthetic runners (cold every 5m, warm every 1m) and alerts for >5% degraded-fallback routing. Fallback contract: response header x-rw-sla=degraded + warning field.
Alex: Rollout plan: enforce priority by default for pilot; opt-in enterprise with capacity commit. Feature-flag enforcement for 14 days post-rollout. We'll log enforcement metrics.
Legal: Any credit/remedy language needs Legal sign-off; please send a short draft SLA + credit table to legal-review channel.
Maya: Action owners/dates:
- Jordan: final SLOs, synth names, fallback spec (48h)
- Elena: public SLA page + pricing matrix draft (72h)
- Priya: oncall rota + triage matrix (EOD)
- Alex: rollout policy + feature-flag plan (72h)
- Ravi: pricing delta + 3-term sims + credit caps (72h)
- Sam: sales one-pager + FAQ (72h)
- Maya: assemble acceptance checklist (96h)
Maya: Blockers?
Priya: Need Legal ASAP on credits.
Maya: I'll ping Legal and add reviewers. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
